title: Register a member
description: Records a member with a name and an email address, refusing an email already registered (TL-LEND-INV01).

title: Add a tool
description: Records a tool with a name and an optional description. A new tool starts in `good` condition.

title: Report damage
description: Sets a tool to `needs_repair` with a note saying what is wrong. Any loan on the tool stays open. A tool that already needs repair is refused, so its first report stands (TL-LEND-INV02).

title: Mark a tool repaired
description: Sets a tool that needs repair back to `good` and clears its damage note. A tool that does not need repair is refused.

title: Borrow a tool
description: Opens a loan of a tool to a member, due 14 calendar days later (TL-LEND-INV04). The checks run in this order, in one transaction, and the first that fails is the reason given: unknown member, unknown tool, the member has an overdue loan, the member is at the loan limit, the tool needs repair, the tool is on loan (TL-LEND-INV03).

title: Return a tool
description: Closes a loan, recording the time, the tool's condition and an optional note, and whether the return was late. A loan already returned is refused (TL-LEND-INV05). It changes only the loan: a tool returned needing repair is taken out of lending by TL-LEND-PO01, which hears Tool returned.

title: Renew a loan
description: Moves an active loan's due date on 14 calendar days from the due date it had. A returned loan, an overdue loan (TL-LEND-SP01) and a loan already renewed (TL-LEND-INV07) are refused, in that order.

title: Remind a member of a due loan
description: Records on an active loan that its member was reminded it is due. A returned loan is refused, and so is a loan whose member was already reminded (TL-LEND-INV08).
